mapper.select: SELECT c.id, LEFT(c.title, 100) AS name, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.config_json, '$.icon')) AS icon, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.config_json, '$.color')) AS color FROM agent_conversation c LEFT JOIN resource_version v ON v.enterprise_id = c.enterprise_id AND v.id = c.agent_version_id WHERE c.enterprise_id = #{enterprise} AND c.user_id = #{user} AND c.mode = 'normal' AND c.status IN ('active','archived') AND LOCATE(#{query}, c.title) > 0 ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT 10
